method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Wind Amulet: Damage (风符·破/風符·破)
skills.line: You have nothing to fear. I am here.
skills.description:
Ichimokuren throws an amulet containing power of the wind at a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK and has a 100% base chance of draining 20% of the target's ATK, lasts for 2 turns.
;Draining : :'''Debuff, Status''': Drains target's ATK.

skills.name: Wind Amulet: Protect (风符·护/風符·守)
skills.description:
Ichimokuren grants Wind's Protection to an ally, it absorbs damage equal to 16% of his max HP and lasts for 2 turns.
When Wind's Protection disappears, it deals damage equal to 12% of his max HP to all enemies. ;Wind's Protection (風護) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Absorbs a certain amount of damage and cannot be dispelled.

upgrades.text: Absorption for Wind's Protection increases to 20%.
When Wind's Protection disappears, move bar for all enemies is decreased by 20%.
'''Upper Hand''': Exclusive effect. This skill is automatically used without onibi on the ally with the highest attack at start of battle.
When an ally with Wind's Protection is inflicted with a debuff or control effect, the move bar for all enemies is decreased by 5% (can be triggered a max of 3 times each turn).

skills.name: Wind Shield (风神之佑/風神の守り)
skills.description: Ichimokuren grants Wind Aegis to all allies. It absorbs damage equal to 12% of his max HP and increases their ATK by 10%, lasts for 2 turns. ; : ;Wind Aegis (風佑) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Absorbs a certain amount of damage and cannot be dispelled.

upgrades.text: Absorption for Wind Aegis increases to 15%.
Absorption for Wind Aegis increases to 18%.
Using this skill on allies already with Wind Aegis grants an additional 20% increase to ATK and 30% of RES (lasts for 1 turn).
Using this skill on allies already with Wind Aegis recovers their HP by 80% of the remaining HP of the shield.

bio.condition: With Ichimokuren clear stage 9 of any Evo zone (solo).
